games.name: HELLFIGHTERS
games.description: A physics-driven co-op game for 4 players about goose firefighters tied together by one fire hose. On the way from a burning city down to Hell, stack into a wobbly tower, fly over pits on extinguisher recoil and haul your friends back up. But if one goose slips, everyone falls...

games.name: RE: Rags to Royalties
games.description: Build a web-novel empire in this incremental management game set in 2004. Tap, upgrade and unleash FEVER; win readers, sign contracts and run a busy studio. With AI-assisted creation, turn your own ideas into a novel you can actually read. Your cat is already on the keyboard.

games.name: Dig Up
games.description: You are Elliot: broke, jobless, out of options. You sign up for a contest with a huge prize and wake up 48 meters underground with a shovel in your hand. Dig, sell, buy ladders and crack the door code hidden in the notes of those who never made it out. The cameras are always watching.

games.name: 牛马的涌现
games.description: A lightweight idle management game that lives along the bottom of your desktop. Hire quirky workers, pair them up to discover new offspring, collect breeds, traits and coats, decorate the office, and expand your company while you work.

games.name: Twilight Park
games.description: Escape the amusement park before it's too late... You were invited to an amusement park, it was supposed to be fun. But soon, you realized you were trapped in the park. Can you escape the park? Investigate the environment, find useful items, solve puzzles, and escape the park before it's too late..

games.name: The Last Button
games.description: Buy block-shaped buttons, fit them onto a floating board and click them for cash. Harder shapes pay bigger multipliers. Coat buttons in 40 materials, let rabbits, drones and a repair robot work for you, ride out storms and meteor showers, and grow your board until the Last Button fits.

games.name: Herb Z
games.description: The world is ending. Business is booming! Run your own survival supply shop in a zombie-infested city. Grow herbs, craft essential supplies, stock your shelves, and serve desperate survivors in this retro-inspired survival horror shop simulator!

games.name: Desktop Gugu: Cozy Idle Pet
games.description: A cozy desktop idle game with two pet species: a mining duck and a leaf-topped mushroom. Sweep up crystals and timber, sell resources, feed your helpers, and combine duck talents. Adjust music and desktop settings to suit your day.

games.name: UnepicTale
games.description: The dragon stole the princess, and now your path leads through dark forests and eerie swamps, teeming with fairy-tale creatures. Flip the card and prove you can handle the choice in the card game UnepicTale!

games.name: Mahjong Kart
games.description: Mahjong meets kart racing! Drive tiles back to your base to collect them, use items to disrupt rivals, and be first to complete a winning hand. Play online with up to four players or face off in local split-screen.

games.name: Robot Crucible
games.description: Build a fighting robot in 5 minutes, or perfect it over 5 hours, then destroy your opponents! Sketch out a chassis, snap on some motors and wheels, choose a weapon, and throw it into the arena against the AI or friends in local multiplayer.

games.name: Cafe Connect
games.description: Repair, upgrade, and build PCs for your first customers to pave your way to self-employment. Open your own internet café, build custom gaming PCs, and expand your shop step by step. Your success starts with a screwdriver.

games.name: RUNEBLADE
games.description: A knight against the endless dark. Three oaths, three lands, ten minutes a run — and a King at the end of each. Your weapons strike on their own: all you choose is where to stand. Fall, and the Sanctum keeps what you carried out.

games.name: Orbit Foundry
games.description: Turn a handful of machines into a bustling factory around a growing star. Orbit Foundry is a space incremental idle game where you reinvest your output, research upgrades, and automate your fleet. Watch production climb as your star changes color.

games.name: Cardelis
games.description: A competitive pixel art card collecting game. Open boosters, build your deck and face real players in PvP. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best!

games.name: Battle Worms
games.description: Get your parts, build your creature, go! Compete with your friends in a series of minigames, adding new parts along the way, to see whose custom creature is the best… or maybe just the funniest. Featuring online PVP, procedural physics and open-ended creature building, how you play is up to you!

games.name: Delta 4 Terminal Protocol
games.description: Wake up to silence. One terminal, one survivor, one dying ship. Can you bring the Delta-4 back online? Delta 4 is a sci-fi survival terminal sim—type commands, decode logs, and fight to keep a dying ship alive.

games.name: Billard Masters Legacy
games.description: Precision cue sports powered by deterministic 1,000 Hz physics! Play 8-Ball, 9-Ball, Snooker, 3-Cushion & Carom in the Online Club or vs PC. Conquer 30 Master Challenges, build custom layouts, and collect 84 cues with live match chronicles across 15 atmospheric 3D venues.

games.name: Incremortal: Xianxia Ascension
games.description: An incremental game about Xianxia cultivation. Slay monsters, gather spiritual qi, refine elixirs, break through realms, and ascend to immortality.

games.name: Mead & Embers: A Viking Tavern
games.description: Take over a Viking tavern in the cold North and make it shine again: build it up, furnish it and look after your guests. With a living village, a tech tree and a winter that is a real opponent. Keep the embers alive.

games.name: BetterAtGambling
games.description: Think you're the best gambler in your friend group? Prove it. Hit the tables, survive the minigames, and if luck runs out, just take the chips from whoever's in the lead. In the end, only one of you is better at gambling.

games.name: Incremental POP: Fishing
games.description: A hoop net, fifteen seconds, a lot of fish. Every round you buy something sillier: harpoons, depth charges, a sea serpent, a whale. Keep going until the screen is mostly fish and the numbers stop making sense.

games.name: Flipside 86
games.description: A coin-flicking roguelike in a neon 1986 casino. Slingshot coins into the bowl, bounce them into a JACKPOT CHAIN, stack CHIPS × MULT, then spend the winnings at Lucky's bar. 100 tables, 10 venues, one House to break. Then let it ride.

games.name: MazeParty
games.description: Ruin your friends' plans and turn the tables in MazeParty, a 4-player online board party game. Roll dice together, navigate a maze in first person, and get in each other's way with items. Earn gold in 20 minigames and collect keys to chase the final victory.

games.name: Scrap to Shelf
games.description: Run a miniature recycling factory on your desk. Sort, process and dismantle scrap by hand, then pack and sell the recovered materials. Fill orders and upgrade equipment as robotic arms and conveyors gradually take over, turning your little factory into a fully automated operation.

games.name: ur round
games.description: a small, cosy co-op pub game for you and your mates, played as birds. a cramped bar, chaotic nights, pop-up trouble and jobs everywhere, and it gets harder every night. you probably won't survive night 7.

games.name: Tidy Garage
games.description: Tidy Garage is a relaxing game about organizing a garage. Sort tools, parts, and all sorts of odds and ends, admire their details, and turn a cluttered garage into a pleasant, tidy space at your own pace.

games.name: Super Empire
games.description: Build a supermarket from a corner store to a hypermarket. Stock shelves that really empty, staff real shifts, price against rival stores, and keep every shopper happy, from dawn delivery to closing time, through every season.

games.name: Skuffle
games.description: 4-player splitscreen online party shooter. Couch and online players in the same match. The splitscreen shooters of your youth with some modern twists. Maps, Modes, Skins, Mutators, Guns, Cigarettes! Oh My! WHAT ELSE DO YOU PEOPLE WANT?

games.name: Meltdown Acres
games.description: Buy cheap land inside the Zone, grow vegetables that change whoever eats them, and sell them to customers who should know better. A dark comedy farming game about a hopeful young farmer, a four-eyed goat, and a harvest nobody can explain.

games.name: FLIP MACHINA
games.description: Reversi meets roguelike. Plant machine stones on the board, flank them to fire them off, and chain your score through charms and upgrades. Build your own scoring engine and go for the legendary eight-way OCTAFLIP in a cozy late-night puzzle shop.

games.name: Pigs and Wolf
games.description: Build. Survive. Drag your home. Lost piggies. A rolling home. Hungry wolves. Play solo or team up with friends to gather resources and survive the night in this chaotic fairy-tale survival adventure.

games.name: BRAZUELA
games.description: Start from scratch and build your own path in Brazuela, a political and life simulation game set in Brazil. Work, study, join a political party, run for office, build relationships, earn positions of power, and take part in the decisions that shape the world around you. Which path will you choose?

games.name: Totally Invited: Party Heist Simulator
games.description: Crash parties, blend in with guests, and escape with the valuables in this co-op stealth heist simulator. Then clean up your haul, stock your shop, and set your prices. Turn stolen goods into a growing business, fund your next heist, and watch out for thieves. Apparently, everyone has the same idea.

games.name: Dear Astronauts
games.description: You and up to three friends crew the world's worst space-tourism rocket. Launch it, fly it, feed the tourists, fix what breaks, go outside when you have to, and try to land with most of them still on board. Online co-op for 1-4 players.

games.name: Ant Tidy Up
games.description: A cozy, quirky sorting game about thousands of ants who aren't where they belong! Explore a sprawling underground world, catch and sort ants into their rightful nests, and unlock upgrades and beetle robots to help tidy up the chaos.

games.name: Grief the Server
games.description: The admins are away. Grief a voxel server in this single-player incremental: sabotage builds, unlock outrageous cheats and become everyone's problem. Simulated players repair, fight back and unite against you. Play in first person or send a bot in Idle Mode.

games.name: THE LAST DELIVERY
games.description: The world ended. The orders didn't. Deliver food and parcels across a dark neon city in VR: drive your own car, climb balconies and radio towers, fight off zombies, and spend every hard-earned euro turning an empty flat into a home.

games.name: Breed a Slime
games.description: Keep a squishy, real-time physics slime right on your desktop! In Breed a Slime, squish and fling slimes while working, breed and mutate traits, collect genes and ornate looks like wings and auras to fill your compendium, found legacy bloodlines, and trade Gene Seeds on the Steam Market!

games.name: Chill Pixels
games.description: *Life can be overwhelming: take a well-deserved, cozy break.* Relax to soothing lo-fi tunes and peaceful ambient sounds while coloring gorgeous pixel art illustrations. Unlock adorable companions, upgrade magical powers in the Zen Workshop, and collect 62 achievements!

games.name: Load Path: Engineering Office Manager
games.description: Run your own engineering firm in this cozy office builder/automation game. You'll get to build your office floor by floor, automate the flow of projects, and play engineering themed mini-games, all whilst trying to not get buried in paperwork.

games.name: Homemade Oxygen
games.description: In the right hands, a wrecked ship can be a ticket home. In Homemade Oxygen, combine cards into production chains, send colonists on expeditions, and keep your crew alive while assembling a ship to escape. On this planet, survival means finding a way out.

games.name: Mouse Hammer
games.description: Mouse Hammer is a fast paced physics based fighting game about swinging a hammer around. Fight online with your friends, or race yourself in platforming challenges.

games.name: Train Keeper
games.description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator aboard a night train. Make beds, set tables and sort up to 2,443 objects across 22 cars before the train reaches the station. Unlock helpful skills, restore order at your own pace, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.

games.name: DataCenter Tycoon
games.description: Build your own Data Center, from a single rack in a garage to a hall full of the latest Hardware. Wire power, cooling and network by hand, keep the machines running, vibe code Products and launch your own AI platform to finance the whole thing. Solo or in online co-op with up to three friends.

games.name: Unstitched
games.description: A social deduction party game for 4–15 players set in a creepy dollhouse. Run minigame errands by night, accuse by day and unmask the Rag Doll. Play online, against bots or Face to Face: one copy on the PC, everyone else plays from their own phone.

games.name: Frog Forage
games.description: Become a frog forager in a cozy incremental farming game. Explore four biomes, hire helpers, brew jam and power up your upgrade tree to make every run better than the last!

games.name: Long Watch
games.description: A short incremental game about an old relay station waking up from deep hibernation. Collect signals, decode the messages they carry, and grow your station into a network across nearby sectors.

games.name: Endless Castle: Under Siege
games.description: Command your heroes, build unstoppable formations, and hold the line against endless waves. Recruit 40 unique heroes, grow stronger even while offline. Turn your castle into an unbreakable fortress.

games.name: Eau de Tycoon
games.description: Dates, work, special occasions. Create perfumes with over 50 different raw materials, scents that people carry with them through key moments in their lives; recommend based on their tastes, customize your packaging, and become an unmatched perfumer.

games.name: My Shitty Life
games.description: Life sucks. Make sure your friends' lives suck worse! My Shitty Life is a darkly comedic 3D board game where you work lousy jobs, pay rent, buy ridiculous items, and sabotage your friends while trying to avoid bankruptcy. Play solo, locally, or with friends through Steam Remote Play Together.

games.name: Tattie Bogle
games.description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

games.name: Toyworks
games.description: A cosy first-person incremental about building a toy workshop that works for you. Drop shapes into funnels, catch the coins, and automate toy production with belts, arms and assemblers. Fill orders, unlock new rooms, and discover where your toys go.

games.name: Incremon Story
games.description: A monster-battling incremental with a story and lots of humor. Hatch your monster, watch it evolve, catch new creatures and take on bosses that don't play fair. Saving the world is the easy part. Getting your mom to stop calling is another story.

games.name: Kiosco Simulator
games.description: Kiosco Simulator is a management sim where you run a 24-hour kiosco in Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina. Serve customers, manage stock, survive the night, and build your reputation as you earn money to upgrade your shop and expand your business.

games.name: One Matter, One Hexagram
games.description: A little ink-turtle lives on your desktop. Ask one question, tap the coin jar, and watch it cast six throws. A woodblock-printed leaf slides in - tear it off, keep it, or export it. Fully offline.

games.name: Bunkum
games.description: Convicts forge their own faces onto dummies, then pose among them. The warden has a flashlight, a mugshot book and not enough cuffs, and can't tell who's real until he cuffs them. A slapstick online party game of bluffing and holding very still, for 3 to 8 players with proximity voice.

games.name: Off the Eaten Path
games.description: Off the Eaten Path is a quiet narrative idle-cooking game: gather ingredients, unlock recipes, fill orders, and keep a handwritten catalogue of everything you taste. The kitchen keeps cooking while you are away.

games.name: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
games.description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

games.name: Tick or Kick!
games.description: Grab them by the leg, check their ticket and throw the freeloaders off the bus. Or ride for free, blend into the crowd and blame someone else. A physics party game about tickets, chaos and flying passengers, for up to 16 friends.
